description:
FILED s532c (Opus agent, 2026-11-08) while confirming #4502's belt.  Not a runaway child: PCL's child does `_exit` (sb-ext:exit :code 127 :abort t) after a failed exec, so the program is never run twice -- the belt #4502 asked about HOLDS.  What differs is the VALUE of open.
PROBES (perl 5.40.3; scratch/s532c/p/4502-2.pl, 4502-3.pl):
  open(P, "/no_such_process_x |")            perl: undef, $! = 2 (ENOENT)      PCL: pid; close false, $? >> 8 = 127, $! 0
  open(P, "| /no_such_process_y")            perl: undef, $! = 2               PCL: pid; close false, 127
  open(P, "-|", "/no_such_process_z", "a")   perl: undef, $! = 2               PCL: pid
  open(P, "/no_such_process_x 2>/dev/null |") (a shell metacharacter: perl execs /bin/sh, which succeeds)
                                              perl: pid, close false, 127       PCL: the same -- correct
MECHANISM (perl): my_popen / my_popen_list open a close-on-exec pipe before the fork; the child writes errno into it when its exec fails and _exits; the parent reads it -- EOF means the exec succeeded, 4 bytes mean it failed: the parent reaps the child, sets errno and returns NULL, so open answers false (util.c, "did_pipes").  io/pipe.t's "child reaped if piped program cannot be executed" row passes today only because it measures the reap, not open's value.
FIX SHAPE: the same pipe in %p-open-fork-pipe (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) for the CMD-ARGS branch: sb-posix:pipe + FD_CLOEXEC on the write end before %p-fork-process; in the child, after p-exec returns, write the errno (4 bytes) and _exit; in the parent, read the read end until EOF -- on 4 bytes waitpid the child, set *p-stored-errno*, close the stream and answer undef.  The direct-exec path only (a command with shell metacharacters execs /bin/sh, which succeeds).  Guard: the three probes above.
subject: A piped open whose program CANNOT BE EXECUTED answers the child's pid in PCL (close then reports status 127); perl's open returns undef with $! = the exec errno (ENOENT) -- `open(P, "/no_such |")`, `open(P, "| /no_such")`, `open(P, "-|", "/no_such", @args)`
